reviews_captured_by_me.text: We had Turnkey Creation do a complete basement finish from the studs up. We could not be happier. Jamison, Toby and Drew as well as the entire crew did a remarkable job. Each member of the team truly wanted to do their best work.  Everyone was polite and well mannered and showed up each day ready to work.  They were very neat and really cleaned up each day.  There was no rushing or taking shortcuts.  It really was a fantastic experience all the way around.  Jamison made a lot of great suggestions and did our layout and design.  He has a tremendous ability to see the final product and really had some great ideas.  Our project turned out way better than we had even pictured.  I would highly recommend Turnkey to anyone planning a building project.  What a great group of guys.  Thank you so much.
